To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the social and informational dimensions are two complementary aspects of the same reality and that the informational dimension is more important than the social one for the success of an online community.

the dynamics of an OCS is characterized by a high degree of interdependence between informational and social aspects and that the dynamics of the OCS is influenced by the type of information that is shared and by the social interactions that take place.
The informational aspect is composed of two constituents, i.e., the quality of the information and the amount of information.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is a need to develop a model that is capable of capturing the social aspects of online communities.

the informational and social aspects of an online community are both necessary for the community's success and that the informational aspects should be the first to be considered when designing a new community.
there is a strong relationship between participation and the social aspects of the community and a weaker relationship between participation and its informational aspects.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed a grid to evaluate online communities from the perspective of information sharing and social aspects of participation in online communities, and we have applied this grid to several online communities.
the social dimension of participation in online communities is more important than the informational dimension.
the informational dimension is the one which characterizes the dynamics of online interactions and reputation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to use a grid as a guide for evaluating the informational and the social aspects of participation in online communities, and for developing models to explore each dimension.
it is important to evaluate the dynamics in both dimensions to understand how online communities work.

it is possible to use an analysis framework to guide the modeling process and that the models that can be built on the basis of the framework are useful to understand the dynamics of online community and to provide guidelines for their design and management.
